final: WITH g AS (SELECT pt.TrackId AS tid, mt.Name AS mname, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY pt.TrackId, mt.Name), s AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g) SELECT g.mname, SUM(g.cnt), AVG(g.cnt * 1.0 / s.total) FROM g JOIN s ON s.total IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.mname ORDER BY g.mname
